corrections.claim: the interaction is 'an order of magnitude smaller than either main effect' and the dominant reading is 'near additivity'
corrections.corrected: all four interaction estimates are negative; one is statistically resolved and three are unresolved. HYBRID consistently attenuates the Stockfish penalty relative to RAW, but the strength of that interaction is only partly resolved
corrections.why_wrong: at H4 on the SF exam the interaction is -0.001131 while the teacher effect on HYBRID is +0.001454 - the same general scale, not an order of magnitude smaller. Three intervals crossing zero also do not establish independence

corrections.claim: explicit structure 'substitutes for a large amount of teacher spend'
corrections.corrected: an economically attractive dominance result - 2.0x teacher spend with structure beats 16.1x without it - and nothing more; identifying substitution would require a pricier teacher that is actually better, which the frozen S13 contracts do not provide
corrections.why_wrong: the more expensive Stockfish teacher is ALSO the worse teacher in every tested cell, so CVS-4k + HYBRID beating SF-32k + RAW is a dominance result and does not identify substitution for beneficial teacher compute
